notes: Mobile App Transcript Design Pass; The draft row gives way at a phone's width: the host's name first (its glyph stays), then the words truncate; the Master reason reads Master needs an admin key. The draft, like a thread, hides the tab bar outside the split. The actions proof makes its new chat by the draft and checks the create carried the first message; the glass set shoots the draft. Docs: IOS-DESIGN.md's project shell and its draft, CLAUDE.md's shell and Steering lines, the client README.; A project's one remembered draft on the phone. With no thread open the shell is the draft: an empty body and the draft composer on the transcript's column, the A10 box (now ComposerBox, shared with a thread's composer), the A11 row with the draft's own mode, and the draft row 4 pt under it: the type with its tinted glyph and its hints, the host of a linked project with New copy through project.ensureLinked, and Master for a chat, which needs an admin key. Text, type, model, effort, mode, Master and host are kept per link key in ProjectDraftStore; photos wait in memory and go up after the thread exists. The first send is session.create with its first message, or create, upload, send and an archive on a failed send; it opens the thread in the shell and clears the draft. Every New thread focuses the draft instead of the sheet, which stays for a prefilled brief. Client: ensureLinked, ProjectDrafts.threadDraft and ensureLinkedParams, the store observable and shared, DraftSendTests.; B4's rules: one remembered draft per project on the phone. ProjectDrafts (Client/ProjectDrafts.swift) keeps a draft per link key, or loose:<workspace key> for a workspace's chats: the text, the type, the model and effort, the permission mode, a chat's Master pick and the host for a linked project; 64 keys, 30 days, in UserDefaults (ProjectDraftStore, project.drafts.v1), the photos in memory only. New thread of a type focuses the draft, takes the type and keeps the text (a type other than chat drops Master); the first send clears it. ThreadDraft gains firstMessage and master (session.create already carries both; Master needs admin, a lesser key sees the reason). DraftSend says how a first send goes out: one create with the message stored as the thread's first row, or with photos the create, the uploads into the new thread and the send, archiving the thread when the send fails; EnvironmentClient.sendDraft runs it. Tests: ProjectDraftsTests (keys, expiry and the cap, the type change, the clear, the send's steps, the admin rule, the store's disk and memory).
